figures.caption: Tē 69 tô.—Siōng-chí ê lîm-pa-kńg kap chôan: g, chhiú ê lîm-pa-kńg ; a, b, tiú-koan-chat lāi-bīn pêng ê lîm-pa-chôan ; c, c, c, koh-ē-khang-nih ê lîm-pa-chôan ; d, heng-khám-pîn ê lîm-pa-chôan óa leng-pông; e, f, só-kut téng-bīn ê lîm-pa-chôan. (From “The Household Physician,” Blackie & Son, Ltd., publishers.)
Tē 70 tô.—Hā-chí kap kái-pîn ê lîm-pa-kńg kap chôan: d, e, f, kái-pîn téng-bīn ê lîm-pa-chôan ; a, b, c, tōa-thúi-chêng-bīn ê lîm-pa-chôan, ū-ê chhián, ū ê chhim. (From as Fig. 69.)
